title: Next.js: Information disclosure across root params when a 'use cache' function is called through unstable_cache()…
description: Next.js versions 16.3.0 through 16.4.4 have a vulnerability where cached data can be disclosed across root route parameters when a 'use cache' function is called both directly during rendering and through unstable_cache(). This occurs due to a race condition during cold process start causing cache entries to be shared improperly across requests with different root params. The issue is fixed in version 16.4.5.
